aliasing: for fixed ratio arms, compare requested cap to nominal ratio*observed BWE; ceiling separate; report clipping shares and current-vs-previous nominal action changes
causality_boundary: observed BWE and present/past acknowledged-cap summaries only; no capacity, schedule, source identity, receiver outcomes, next actions, encoder output or future duration in predictors
contrasts: source-mean paired MAE differences versus persistence and state_ridge; descriptive t intervals, conditional on fits, not independent model-training replication
horizon_boundary: short pilots use nominal 3 s holds; ladder fast cuts and margin can shorten the next epoch; prediction is next-epoch, not a fixed 3 s forecast
limitations: No actual encoded payload history is available in the compact summaries.
Predictive incremental cap information is not a causal action-value or QoE effect.
All panels are previously read development evidence on four authored schedules and twelve sources.
Source/regime CV partitions do not create an untouched validation panel.
No calibrated safety probability, closed-loop learned policy, or revised simulator is evaluated.

partitions.regime_cv: train on range, leave each complete authored network regime out; no hyperparameter selection
partitions.source_cv: train on range, leave each complete source out; no hyperparameter selection
partitions.transfer: fit once on all range sessions, freeze, describe ladder and margin; both already read, same sources; not blind validation

target: log(next observed BWE / current BWE), at the next actuation epoch; no future duration input
weights: equal source/regime/arm cells; equal sessions within a cell; equal epochs within a session
